source.adaptation: The pinned Magpie reference supplies the existing Gemini-to-Chat stimulus basis only. This budget scenario is a local RCC regression from materialized_sse_incremental_budget.rs: 32 valid Chat data frames carry 4096 text bytes. The terminal is deliberately withheld by the existing hold-open mock; the 1024-byte budget must close the client connection before the test deadline. Client timeout is failure, not a close receipt. This does not assert a remote per-frame poll count.
